# Code of conduct

Agentium adopts the [Contributor Covenant, version 2.1](https://www.contributor-covenant.org/version/2/1/code_of_conduct/). It applies in the repository's issues, pull requests, discussions and reviews, and wherever someone represents the project.

In short: be respectful, assume good faith and critique the work, not the person. Harassment, personal attacks, discriminatory language and publishing someone's private information are not acceptable.

## Reporting

This repository belongs to a personal account, so GitHub does not offer reports to repository admins here. Report behavior to GitHub instead:
- on an issue, pull request or comment, open the **⋯** menu, choose **Report content**, then **Report abuse to GitHub Support**
- for a user account or anything else, use [GitHub's abuse report form](https://support.github.com/contact/report-abuse)

For any other concern, open an issue that mentions @pigeaca and asks for a private channel, without the details.

## Enforcement

The maintainer decides how to respond, following the Covenant's enforcement guidelines: correction, warning, temporary ban or permanent ban.
